consequence.statement: Environments that had disabled the AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature gate will have additional certificate output formats always enabled after upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Check whether anything relied on the feature being disabled, and remove the explicit gate setting.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0 the AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature gate is promoted to GA, so additional certificate output formats are always enabled.
